title: Coherence of normalized common-stage Hom comparisons
statement: Fix the common-stage Hom data and a coefficient inclusion L ≤ M. After transporting the normalized Hom representative from L to M, the operation-stage transition and stage-system associators identify it with the normalized comparison at M applied to the transported input arrows.

source.place: The common-stage internal-Hom comparison definition; missing coherence between operationStageTransitionIso, normalized rational Hom comparisons, and stage-system associators.

proof.text: Bundle the specified rational Hom comparisons into natural isomorphisms on the permitted rational-pair categories. Their naturality is exactly specifiedHomScalarRational_naturality, including the reversed first arrow.

Transport the rational Hom tower equation along the coefficient-inclusion composition law. The uniqueness specification for the stage system identifies its transitions and associators with these normalized scalar functors and associators. Substituting equal transition data proves the forward and inverse transition-identification tower equations.

For each input, define its correction as the inverse transition identification followed by the stage associator. Naturality of the transition identification and the stage cocycle show that these corrections satisfy the scalar tower equation. Take the inverse correction in the contravariant input and the forward correction in the covariant input. Functoriality of Hom and naturality of the rational comparison now give the object comparison tower and the one-step naturality square.

Apply the categorical conjugation calculation: substitute the two object comparison tower equations into the transported arrow, move the Hom arrow by one-step naturality, and cancel the inverse comparison maps. The result is exactly the displayed commonStageHomComparison_hom_square.

proof_origin.place: The proved scalar coherence support module and private input-correction lemmas assemble the common-stage square. No new obligation is introduced.

theorem commonStageHomComparison_hom_square
    (M : Index l Ω) (k : L ≤ M) :
    let cP_L := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W P L h
    let cQ_L := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W Q L h'
    let cP_M := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W P M (h.trans k)
    let cQ_M := commonStageHomComparison l Ω W Q M (h'.trans k)
    ((stageSystem l Ω W).assoc h k).inv.app
          (commonStageHomObject l Ω W P).obj ≫
      ((stageSystem l Ω W).T k).map
        (cP_L.hom ≫
          (rationalDerivedInternalHom l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) W).map
            (ObjectProperty.homMk
              (X := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W P L h)
              (Y := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W Q L h') (Prod.mkHom a.op b)) ≫
          cQ_L.inv) ≫
      ((stageSystem l Ω W).assoc h' k).hom.app
          (commonStageHomObject l Ω W Q).obj =
    cP_M.hom ≫
      (rationalDerivedInternalHom l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω M) W).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W P M (h.trans k))
          (Y := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω W Q M (h'.trans k))
          (Prod.mkHom ((stageSystem l Ω W).tr k a).op
            ((stageSystem l Ω W).tr k b))) ≫
      cQ_M.inv
